# When the sumdb returns a response which does not
# include a sum for the requested module,
# we should report an error.
# Verifies CVE-2026-42501.
env sumdb=$BOLERO_SUMDB
env proxy=$BOLERO_PROXY
env BOLERO_PROXY BOLERO_NOPROXY BOLERO_SUMDB BOLERO_NOSUMDB

# /sumdb-redirect/ causes the sumdb to return /lookup/ responses
# for rsc.io/quote@v1.0.0, not for the requested module.
env BOLERO_SUMDB=$sumdb' '$proxy/sumdb-redirect/rsc.io/quote@v1.0.0:

! bolero get rsc.io/fortune@v1.0.0
stderr 'SECURITY ERROR'
! grep rsc.io go.sum
-- go.mod --
module m
